title: Recursive AI Engineering
goal: Evolve RAE into a recursively growing, context-efficient engineering system that operates through one manually started GPT conversation at a time.
summary: Recursive tree bootstrap is implemented on branch ai/2daceac7-recursive-engineering-tree and is under review in PR #28. The root index, local node schema, bounded attention index, lazy session startup, repository-local context contract, and structural CI test are present. The recursive-tree CI passed on commit 49752ec865853fff3d9aad3df7f5a007f4a64467; shell and PostgreSQL checks are still running for that exact head. Existing Supabase schema, projects, Workers, tasks, and execution history remain unchanged. Open PR #26 still conflicts with the confirmed single-session runtime boundary and has been flagged without modification.
